jobs.title: Portfolio Managers
jobs.description:
BUILD YOUR REAL ESTATE CAREER IN DUBAI!

Are you in India and looking for an exciting opportunity in Dubai’s booming real estate market?

We are HIRING CANDIDATES FROM INDIA.

Who Can Apply?

* 6 Months – 2 Years of Real Estate Experience
* Strong Communication & Sales Skills
* Passion for Real Estate
* Willingness to Relocate to Dubai

What We Offer:

* Competitive Salary
* Employment Visa
* Commission
* Good communication skills in English and Hindi.

This is your chance to take your real estate career from India to Dubai!

Interested candidates can share their updated CV at hr@keyestone.ae.

Pay: AED2,000.00 - AED5,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in financial analytics, Finance MIS, internal audit, or internal controls.
* Practical experience in Power BI dashboards, advanced Excel, and ERP reporting.
* Good understanding of accounting processes, internal controls, risk assessments, and financial reporting.
* Experience in FMCG, distribution, trading, or multi-entity organisations preferred.
* Exposure to internal audit testing, process reviews, and SOP compliance assessments will be an advantage.

**Educational Qualifications**:

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Analytics, or a related discipline.
* ACCA, CMA, CIMA, CIA, or equivalent professional qualifications will be an advantage.
* Certification in Power BI, SQL, Data Analytics, or Internal Auditing will be preferred.

Application Question(s):

* Current Salary:
* Expected Salary:
* Relevant UAE Experience (in years):
* Total Experience (in years):

* Visa Type:

Work Location: In person
